input.quote: 14.3 Choice of Law; Arbitration; Venue. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, USA, excluding conflict of laws provisions and excluding the 1980 United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with the then-current commercial arbitration rules of the American Arbitration Association ("RULES"). The arbitration shall be conducted by one (1) arbitrator appointed in accordance with the Rules in San Francisco County, California.
input.rationale: Section 14.3 selects California law, an accepted jurisdiction under the fallback position (Delaware or California law and courts), and places the forum in San Francisco County, California, with judgments enforceable in the San Francisco courts. The mandatory AAA arbitration is seated domestically in California, so it does not raise the walk-away concern of a foreign seat or exclusive foreign venue, and the jurisdiction is not the counterparty's foreign home forum. The clause therefore sits at the fallback rather than the preferred position (New York law and the state and federal courts in New York County); the substitution of binding domestic arbitration for a pure court forum is a sub-element short of preferred wording and is noted here rather than redlined, particularly as the California seat is convenient to us.
